parsed.rationale: All four records in this cluster are either the canonical type-alias declaration or extension points for `PlaybackReason` spread intentionally across package boundaries: the core definition lives in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/PlaybackReason.swift` (package `Playback`), a UI-layer extension lives in `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/Sources/PlayerHeaderView/PlaybackReason+PlayerHeaderView.swift` (package `PlayerHeaderView`), and an app-layer extension lives in `WXYC/iOS/PlaybackReason+App.swift` (package `app:iOS`). This is the standard Swift pattern of declaring a type once and extending it in each consuming layer — the 'name collision' is the intended extension mechanism, not accidental duplication.
